sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-6,400 (levels 1-12). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Nox Nostra unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Improved Spirit. Ultimate (Nox Nostra) is available from Extra Stamina.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 18.5 to Love Bites's bonus damage (1.85x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Rake (120) clears its 80-damage trigger.

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.caption: Imbued on Rake: the imbue charges up over 18s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 10% fire rate for 12s.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Imbued on Rake: widens its range.
items.why: imminent: Improved Spirit completes 4.8k spirit in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. +18 spirit adds about 33.3 to Love Bites's bonus damage (1.85x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Reactive Barrier, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Reactive Barrier, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 6,400-17,600 (levels 12-24). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rake T3, Love Bites T3. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Reactive Barrier.

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Reactive Barrier completes 800 souls on. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Reactive Barrier completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Grit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you. Takes vitality from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Swift Striker
items.why: weapon investment only and the build never reaches the 4.8k weapon tier through the core: timing review

items.name: Spirit Sap
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Rake: takes 18% off its 8s base cooldown. Takes spirit from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 17,600-26,400 (levels 24-28). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Sanguine Retreat T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Love Bites, bonus damage) grows from 266 to 355.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 55.5 to Love Bites's bonus damage (1.85x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Love Bites (355), Rake (270) clear its 165-damage trigger. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 26,400-46,400 (levels 28-35). Your biggest single spirit hit (Love Bites, bonus damage) grows from 355 to 474.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 15,200 to 21,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 21,600 to 23,200 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. | With 3 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 135s; 20% off is 27s per full rotation.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Infuser
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 9,600 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Imbued on Rake: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s. Takes spirit from 25,600 to 30,400 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Upgrade of Quicksilver Reload (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Spirit Sap.
sections.desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Spirit Sap.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is melting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Big spirit bursts catch you when you go in.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult you can see coming, like Lash's or Infernus's.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Sanguine Retreat (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep catching you before you blink.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They keep jumping you and you can't blink out.

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Focus Lens
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Spirit Sap for 4,800 more souls: resist reduction duration 0 to 12; bonus fire rate 0 to 10..
items.legacy_note: Upgrade of Spirit Sap. Throw it on them, then ult.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Indomitable
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Reactive Barrier for 4,800 more souls: cooldown reduction on proc 0 to 20; bullet resist 0 to 10..

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: On Rake. Sell Tankbuster for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Takes vitality from 14,400 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.caption: Nox Nostra deals damage (damage), so it applies the item's 0.75s stun after a 3s delay plus 150 damage. Replaces Mercurial Magnum: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 14,400 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
